newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile senate approves Canada trade accord-minister.
newsitem.headline: Chile senate approves Canada trade accord-minister.

text.p: The Chilean senate ratified a free trade agreement with Canada Wednesday, Government Minister Juan Villarzu said.
"We've got the votes. It's done," Villarzu told Reuters during the vote at Congress in the port of Valparaiso.
Villarzu and Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said more than the 26 senators needed for the treaty's passage had already cast their votes in favor.
The agreement will erase tariffs on 80 percent of trade between the two countries and phase out the rest over the next 18 years.
The voting process was lengthy, because legislators may accompany their votes with speeches.
Villarzu said the treaty would win over 30 votes in favour.
It was opposed by some rightist senators from farming regions in southern Chile who believed their constituents would be hurt by Canadian agricultural imports.
